# TA-Lib (vendored)

C Technical Analysis Library (BSD-3-Clause). Used by `src/charts/Indicators.cpp`
to compute stock-chart indicator math (SMA/EMA/BBANDS/RSI/MACD/STOCH) that
previously was hand-rolled.

- **Source:** https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib (official C/C++ home)
- **Version:** 0.7.1 (release tag `v0.7.1`, 2026-07-03)
- **Tarball:** `ta-lib-0.7.1-src.tar.gz`

## Vendored tree

```
include/                public headers (ta_common.h, ta_defs.h, ta_func.h,
                        ta_func_unguarded.h, ta_abstract.h, ta_libc.h,
                        ta_config.h)
src/ta_common/          version/global/memory/return-code plumbing
src/ta_func/            the 162 indicator .c files + ta_utility.{h,c},
                        ta_func_private.h  — all AUTO-GENERATED by ta_codegen
                        ("AUTO-GENERATED ... DO NOT EDIT"), vendored as-is
src/ta_abstract/        function registry: ta_abstract.c, ta_func_api.c,
                        ta_group_idx.c, ta_def_ui.c, frames/ta_frame.c,
                        tables/table_*.c
LICENSE                 upstream BSD-3-Clause license text
CMakeLists.txt          static-library build for Scriba
```

Scriba vendors the whole library (not just the six functions scriba calls) so
future indicators (ATR, CCI, ADX, ...) become available with no further
vendoring. The upstream build system (autotools `configure`, Makefiles,
`src/tools/`) is NOT vendored.

## Configuration

`include/ta_config.h` is normally generated by upstream's autotools from
`ta_config.h.in`. Scriba vendors a static copy instead (see the header comment
in that file). In v0.7.1 no source file `#include`s it, so the exact macro
values are inert — they mirror what configure would produce on a typical
glibc/musl Linux system. Refresh them when upgrading.

## Upgrade procedure

1. Copy the new release's `include/`, `src/ta_common/`, `src/ta_func/` and
   `src/ta_abstract/` over the vendored trees (the three `src` dirs are picked
   up by `file(GLOB ... CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)` in `CMakeLists.txt`, so new `.c`
   files need no CMake edits).
2. Refresh `include/ta_config.h` if the `ta_config.h.in` template changed.
3. Update the version line above.
4. Re-check the lookbacks and conventions consumed by
   `src/charts/Indicators.cpp` and `tests/test_indicators.cpp`.

No patch workflow: TA-Lib sources are unmodified upstream (besides the static
`ta_config.h`).

## License note

TA-Lib is BSD-3-Clause, NOT GPL. The original license header is preserved
intentionally in every vendored file — this deviation from the repo's usual
"GPL header on vendored files" rule is a deliberate decision (the vendored
files are unmodified upstream source, and the permissive BSD-3-Clause license
is compatible with GPL-3.0 use). Do not add the GPL header to the vendored
TA-Lib files; their upstream license text is authoritative.
